description:
This 1.39" AMOLED Bluetooth calling smartwatch is built for people who want a bright, premium-looking round dial and the freedom to answer calls from the wrist. The high‑resolution 464×464 AMOLED display pops with deep blacks and vivid color, so messages, caller ID, and watch faces look crisp indoors or under harsh daylight. Pair it to your phone and use the built‑in speaker and mic for quick calls on the move. Need hands-free control? Tap the voice assistant to call, set reminders, or check info without pulling out your phone.

For everyday wellness, it tracks heart rate and sleep, plus daily activity to keep you aware and consistent. Finished with a classic brown leather‑style strap and a clean metallic-look frame, it fits office hours, workouts, and weekends. Works with Android and iOS for easy syncing and smart notifications that keep you in the loop without distraction.
